title: Freejack
description: Bounty hunters from the future transport a doomed race car driver to New York City in 2009, where his mind will be replaced with that of a dead billionaire.

title: Blitz
description: A tough cop (Jason Statham) goes after a serial killer who targets police officers.

title: The Gunman
description: A former Special Forces soldier (Sean Penn) who has PTSD tries to reconnect with his longtime lover, but must first find out who wants him dead... and why.

title: Eye See You
description: While staying at a clinic for therapy, an FBI agent (Sylvester Stallone) searches for a serial killer who is murdering the staff and patients.

title: Code Name Banshee
description: A former government assassin is forced out of hiding when his deadly protégé, known as Banshee, discovers there is a bounty on his life. To survive, they must fight off the CIA-backed killers coming for them.

title: Operator
description: When the daughter of a dispatcher and a cop is kidnapped, they are forced to follow the kidnapper's rules and have to choose to save their daughter or the city.

title: Mercenary for Justice
description: A soldier of fortune (Steven Seagal) seeks revenge after staging a daring jailbreak and being double-crossed.

title: Agent Red
description: A Marine commander (Dolph Lundgren) accompanies a submarine carrying a chemical virus to a secure storage facility.

title: American Yakuza
description: An undercover FBI agent has risen through the ranks of the Yakuza and now finds himself caught in a war between the Yakuza, the mob and the FBI.

title: Direct Contact
description: An American prisoner in a Russian jail is given the chance for freedom if he is able to rescue a kidnapped American woman.

title: The Contract
description: A man (John Cusack) and his young son (Jamie Anderson) encounter an assassin (Morgan Freeman) while hiking in a forest.

title: K-19: The Widowmaker
description: The commander (Harrison Ford) of a Russian submarine tries to avert a disaster after a nuclear reactor malfunctions.

title: Honest Thief
description: Hoping to cut a deal, a professional bank robber agrees to return all the money he stole in exchange for a reduced sentence. But when two FBI agents set him up for murder, he must now go on the run to clear his name and bring them to justice.

title: The Code
description: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.

title: Cover-Up
description: An American journalist (Dolph Lundgren) gets too close to the truth about alleged terrorist attacks in Tel Aviv.

title: Gunfight at Rio Bravo
description: A mysterious Russian gunslinger aids a marshal and a sheriff in a standoff with an outlaw gang who have invaded their town.

title: Derailed
description: An undercover operative (Jean-Claude Van Damme) battles terrorists after they seize a train containing biological weapons.

title: JCVD
description: Weary action star Jean-Claude Van Damme (Jean-Claude Van Damme) returns to Belgium to find relief from his troubles but instead stumbles into a bank robbery.

title: Arlington Road
description: A U.S. history professor (Jeff Bridges), obsessed with radical groups, thinks his new neighbors (Tim Robbins, Joan Cusack) may be domestic terrorists.

title: In Hell
description: Kyle LeBlanc winds up incarcerated in Russia after he takes revenge on the man who murdered his wife. He is assigned to a prison that is renowned for its violence. Controlled by a corrupt warden, the facility holds brutal fights between inmates.

title: Survivor
description: Framed for a terrorist bombing, a foreign service officer (Milla Jovovich) must dodge a top assassin (Pierce Brosnan), while racing against time to thwart a deadly plot.

title: Castle Falls
description: A hospital is packed with dynamite and ready to be demolished, but no one knows that a gang leader hid $3 million in stolen cash inside. Now, three desperate parties want the money -- and they have exactly 90 minutes to find it and get out alive.

title: American Yakuza
description: An undercover FBI agent has risen through the ranks of the Yakuza and now finds himself caught in a war between the Yakuza, the mob and the FBI.

title: Abduction
description: A man steps out of a fountain in a park in Ho Chi Minh City with no memory of who he is. He wanders the city trying to piece together his past while being pursued by mysterious figures.

title: The 51st State
description: A chemist (Samuel L. Jackson) who produces illegal drugs travels to Liverpool, England, to negotiate one last deal before he retires.

title: Stolen
description: A former thief (Nicolas Cage) has just 12 hours to come up with $10 million after his former partner (Josh Lucas) kidnaps his daughter and locks her in a cab.

title: If... Dog... Rabbit
description: When a criminal is released from prison, he promptly returns to a life of crime with his lawbreaking brother.
